purpose: Binding correction overlay for all P1/P2 findings discovered before DEV03-WP03. Historical accepted WP02/PREP05/PREP07/PREP08 artifacts remain immutable evidence; where this contract is more specific or conflicts, this contract is authoritative for WP03 implementation.

AUD-20260928-02-F01.title: Exact parent v2 verified-transfer binding

collection_transaction_id_contract.purpose: Stable identity of the successfully verified parent v2 transfer; not a meteorological record identity and not a v3 retry identity.

AUD-20260928-02-F01.public_workflow_requirement: The successful v2 transfer step must expose a machine-readable local result containing the immutable receipt path/SHA and verified_data_commit_sha, or the v3 builder must independently resolve and verify the immutable receipt from the private repository before any v3 network request.
AUD-20260928-02-F01.fail_closed: No exact verified parent receipt => do not generate or transfer v3.

AUD-20260928-02-F02.title: Exact parent provider-cycle pinning

parent_cycle_binding_id.formula: sha256(canonical sorted inventory of the binding dimensions for all parent retained occurrences)

rules: V3-only acquisition must use the exact run/cycle represented by each parent occurrence.
Do not invoke newest-cycle or mature-cycle selection for the v3-only field fetch.
Do not attach a field whose provider run/valid/product/grid identity differs from the parent occurrence.
If the exact parent-cycle field is no longer available, persist typed not_yet_published or fetch_error evidence according to actual failure; never substitute a newer cycle.

AUD-20260928-02-F03.title: Lossless parent native-field inventory before whole-occurrence replacement

inventory_contract.field_identity_algorithm: Use the same canonical native-field identity algorithm used by Archive-v6; registry version itself is not a field-identity dimension.

replacement_precondition: Every parent received native field identity/variant is present in v6 as received evidence with the same native identity.
Every explicit parent availability subject is preserved in v6 with a causally valid status/evidence trail.
Registry-v3-only fields may add evidence but may not replace or collapse parent identities.
parent_field_inventory_sha256 is persisted and verified before linked v5 whole-occurrence suppression.
AUD-20260928-02-F03.failure_behavior: If parent inventory cannot be reconstructed exactly or v6 is not a lossless superset, v6 is not replacement-eligible; retain causal v5 and report degraded/invalid successor diagnostics.

AUD-20260928-02-F04.title: Archive-v6 immutable publication transaction
publisher_rules: All dated Archive-v6 Parquet fragments, manifests and publication receipts are immutable and conflicting bytes at an existing path are fatal.
Any publisher used by WP03 must explicitly classify data/weather_archive_v6/ immutable; the existing publish_products.py rule for data/weather_archive/ is not sufficient.

Archive-v6 fragments/manifests, shadow immutable snapshot and archive publication receipt must be committed in one shadow-only Git publication transaction or an equivalent CAS-safe atomic publication.
AUD-20260928-02-F04.reader_rule: Archive-v6 readers may enumerate only manifests authorized by a valid publication receipt. Unreceipted/orphan fragments or manifests are invisible and diagnostic-only.
AUD-20260928-02-F04.fail_closed: Publication failure never advances shadow latest/promotion_state and never creates reader-visible v6 evidence.

AUD-20260928-02-F05.title: Shared Availability-v3 state family and precedence
mapping_precedence: If provider capability is unsupported for the exact provider product, use unsupported_by_provider_or_product even if acquisition policy is also disabled.
If the provider capability is native/available but policy deliberately disables retrieval, use not_requested_by_policy.
Use intentionally_not_applicable only for a semantically inapplicable provider representation, never as a generic missing state.
Use not_yet_published only when the exact pinned provider cycle/field is expected but not yet published.
Use fetch_error only for an attempted exact pinned retrieval that failed.
Use unknown_or_ambiguous only when available evidence cannot safely distinguish supported states; include explicit reason/evidence.
invariants: Only received may carry a value.
Unknown states outside this family are rejected.

AUD-20260928-02-F06.title: Complete Ensemble-v3 native field identity
rules: Compute field_identity_id after the valid-time-specific native interval metadata is known.
Different complete native step identities must produce different field_identity_id values.
interval_seconds is normalized interval authority but is not a substitute for preserving native step identity.
Registry version is provenance and must not by itself change an otherwise identical native field identity.

AUD-20260928-02-F07.title: V3 attempt/retry identity

v3_attempt_id_contract.rule: collection_transaction_id stays stable for all attempts of one verified parent; v3_attempt_id is unique per causal attempt.

AUD-20260928-02-F07.immutable_path_rule: Public v3 payload/integrity/receipt and private shadow snapshot/promotion receipt paths must include v3 attempt timestamp and/or v3_attempt_id so two legitimate attempts for one parent never collide.
AUD-20260928-02-F07.retry_rule: A later retry may improve fetch_error/not_yet_published into received evidence as a new causal v3 attempt; it never rewrites an earlier attempt.

AUD-20260928-02-F08.title: Cross-archive ensemble source-set deduplication
AUD-20260928-02-F08.unchanged_set_rule: Copied unchanged ensemble source evidence must retain the same ensemble_source_revision_set_id used by v5.
v6_over_v5_precondition: v6 publication receipt is valid and visible at as_of
all member values for the represented received-member set reference the same source set
any member-derived aggregate references the same member_set/source_member_revision_set identity
no v5/v6 rows are composed into one source set
AUD-20260928-02-F08.provider_summary_rule: QA-only provider summaries without ensemble_source_revision_set_id receive a deterministic archive adapter summary identity plus parent_v2_payload_sha256; exact linked duplicates are exposed once, never counted as a model-family contribution.
AUD-20260928-02-F08.failure_behavior: If v6 set atomicity/preservation fails, keep the complete causal v5 set and mark successor degraded; do not partially prefer v6.

AUD-20260928-02-F09.title: Byte-identical shared WP03 execution authority
AUD-20260928-02-F09.shared_contract_rule: This correction contract is the byte-identical shared authority in public and private repositories for all cross-repository clauses discovered by AUD-20260928-02.

AUD-20260928-02-F10.title: Separate parent and v3 temporal provenance
rules: parent_v2_collector_generated_at_utc is immutable parent correlation metadata and never represents v3 evidence creation time.
v3_generated_at_utc is the v3 attempt creation/finalization time and orders v3 latest pointers.
Each newly fetched v3 field preserves availability_observed_at_utc and, when received, field_available_at_utc from the actual v3 fetch observation.
Private v3 first_seen is the first verified private visibility of that exact v3_attempt_id and is never copied from parent v2.
Archive-v6 revision/source chronology uses actual v3 evidence and private first-seen times; parent time is retained only as lineage.

shared_native_field_identity_v1.canonicalization: UTF-8 canonical JSON; object keys sorted; no NaN; native numeric step values normalized losslessly before hashing

archive_v6_replacement_v2.deterministic_occurrence_link: migration_source_occurrence_id remains based on logical_record_id + verified parent_v2_payload_sha256
required_before_deterministic_replacemen: causal v3 private first_seen at as_of
archive_v6_replacement_v2.ensemble_rule: Apply FIX-F08 source-set-level precedence separately from deterministic occurrence precedence.

required_adversarial_regressions: correct parent payload hash but wrong/unverified parent receipt
provider publishes newer cycle between v2 transfer and v3-only fetch
parent has two native variants under one semantic and v3 drops one
orphan v6 manifest exists without publication receipt
unsupported capability plus not-requested policy maps to unsupported
two ensemble fields differ only by native step range
fetch_error v3 attempt followed by received retry for same parent
same ensemble source set exists in v5 and v6
v3 new field time occurs after parent generation time
